metadata.title: Non-connected minimal clusters of small volume in a compact Finsler manifold
metadata.abstract: We prove that isoperimetric clusters in general Finsler manifolds can be disconnected even when the volume constraint is small. This is in contrast with the Riemannian case and the ``fixed-norm'' case, where connectedness for arbitrarily small volume has recently been proved.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 紧Finsler流形中任意小体积极小cluster的非连通例
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明一般Finsler流形的等周cluster即使体积约束很小也可以不连通，与黎曼及fixed-norm情形的任意小体积连通性结果形成区别。
analysis.breakthrough: 表明随位置变化的Finsler几何可破坏小体积极小cluster连通性。
analysis.limitations: 这是存在非连通例，不是所有Finsler流形的小体积cluster都不连通；cluster的腔室数与体积比例条件摘要未列。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
